class: Two parts that meet through a file, each waiting for the other to make it
symptom: Rackspace: the run stopped for the owner, and the dashboard showed no Continue button; Resume refused because the run was still going, so the owner had no way to let it carry on.
root_cause: The agent waits for data/_signal_<run>.txt to appear, and pressing Continue is what writes it; the dashboard showed its 'Waiting for a decision' card only for signal files that already existed. So the button appeared only after the answer it sends had been sent. Nothing marked a run as waiting.
why_tests_missed: No test put a run into the wait and looked at the dashboard at the same time; the signal tests wrote the file directly.
fix: wait_for_signal() writes data/_waiting_<run>.txt while it waits and removes it when the wait ends; web_ui.waiting_runs() lists those notes, labelled with the job's title and company, each with Continue (writing the signal file), Reload agent code, Skip and Close browser.
prevention: When two processes hand over through a file, the waiting side announces that it waits; test the hand-over end to end, the waiting side and the UI together.
